channel.title: Te NGz
channel.desc: In a game of hide and seek, Moemiti, hidden underneath the plum tree, watches Ng?tai trying to find her. When a plum falls on Ng?tai's head making Moemiti laugh! Ngatai finds her sis, and an abundance of plums! What do they do to make sure the plums don?t go to waste? (R).
